race.comment: UP THE FRONT (2) last appeared four weeks ago over 1200m at Kembla Grange when he finished fifth. This is his first run for the Brent Stanley stable and is looks a couple of levels below what he's been racing in of late. LAKE GILLEAR (6) has not won for a long while and comes off a fifth at Moe over 1000m after being up on the pace until straightening. It's a long way from Mornington to Mildura and the Harris/Walker camp wouldn't bother with it if they didn't think it was a race he could win. SHAMATEUR (7) has found only one better the past two starts, beaten 1.5 lengths and three quarters of a length, and will be aided by gate one. SURPRISATIC (1) got turned over at a short quote last start, but just missed out in a photo, and has good experience here, which could prove a plus. Does have a lot of weight, though. ROYAL TURF (4) gave away a considerable start over 1200m at Bairnsdale last time before hitting the line well to finish fourth. Could be ready to peak third-up.
